National Foreword

This Indian Standard, which is identical with IEC Pub 115-2-l / QC 400101 (1982) `Fixed resistors for use in electronicequipment,Part 2: Blank detail specification: Fixed low-power nonwirewound resistors-Assessment level E', issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on 9 August 1988 on the recommendation of Resistors Sectional Committee and approval of the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council (LTDC). Wherever the words `International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as `Indian Standard'.
Cross References

In this Indian Standard, the following Inter ,._,ional Standards are referred to. Read in their respective place the following: International Standard IEC Pub 1IS-l-Fixed resistors for use in electronic equipment, Part 1: Generic specification IEC Pub 1is-2 Part 2: Sectional specification: Fixed low-power nonwirewound resistors Corresponding Indian Standard IS QC 400000 Fixed resistors for use in electronic equipment: Generic specifi cation specification: Fixed low-power non-wirewound resistors
IS _QC 400100 Sectional

The technical committee responsible for the preparation of this standard has reviewed the provisions of the following International Publications and, has decided that they are acceptable for use in conjunction with this standardl: IEC Pub 63 Preferred numbers series for resistors and capacitors IEC Pub 410 (1973) Sampling plans and procedures for inspection bv attributes This standard is intended primarily for use under the IECQ system. A regular Indian Standard for this component could be different, identical or similar to this standard. Only the English language text in the International Standard has been retained while adopting it in this standard.

Blank detail specification A blank detail specification is a supplementary document to the Sectional Specification and contains requirements for style and layout and minimum content of detail specifications. Detail Specifications not complying with these requirements shall not be considered as being in accordance with I EC Specifications nor shall they be so described.
